FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-HOME-005 | US001 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Strategic Direction Section — Visitor Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to view the Strategic Direction section (Vision, Mission,
Objectives pillars) on the Home Page
So that
I can understand Qatar Chamber's strategic pillars and
organizational direction
Preconditions:
- The Strategic Direction section is published and active
in the CMS.
- At least one strategic pillar card is published and
active.
Frontend Workflow:
1. Visitor scrolls to the Strategic Direction section on the
Home Page.
2. The section renders with the section tag, heading, description, and
strategic pillar cards.
3. Visitor reads each pillar card: icon, pillar title (e.g.,
Vision, Mission, Objectives), and description text.
4. Animation effect on the pillar same as we have in the Figma
with left and right arrow
5. The section is fully responsive on all screen sizes.
Given the
visitor scrolls to the Strategic Direction section
When the
section renders
Then
- The system shall display the section tag, heading, and
description in the active language.
- The system shall display all active strategic pillar
cards with icon, title, and description.
- The section content shall render in the active language
(EN/AR) and layout shall mirror for Arabic.
- The section shall be fully responsive on all screen
sizes.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If no strategic pillar card is active, the Strategic
Direction section shall not render on the Home Page.
Post Condition:
- Visitor can view Qatar Chamber's strategic pillars on
the Home Page.
BACKEND — Admin CMS
Management
User Story ID
QC-HOME-005 | US002 | REF: FR-004
Title
Strategic Direction Section — CMS Management
As a
authorized admin user (Site Content Editor)
I want
to manage the Strategic Pillars content (Vision, Mission,
Objectives) displayed on the Home Page in Liferay CMS
So that
visitors see the current and accurate strategic direction
of Qatar Chamber
Preconditions:
- Admin user has the appropriate role to manage Home Page
content in Liferay CMS.
Administrator Workflow:
1. Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
2. Navigates to Home Page → Strategic Direction Section
Management.
3. Configures the section tag, heading, and description
(bilingual).
4. Clicks Add Pillar Card — enters: pillar icon image, pillar
title (bilingual), and description (bilingual).
5. Sets display order and active status for each pillar card.
6. Saves as draft, previews, and publishes the section.
7. System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast
message.
8. Published pillar cards reflect in the Strategic Direction
section after cache refresh.
Given the admin
opens Strategic Direction management in the CMS
When the admin
creates, edits, or publishes a pillar card
Then
- The system shall allow the admin to configure the
section tag, heading, and description (bilingual).
- The system shall allow the admin to add, edit, and
delete strategic pillar cards.
- Each pillar card shall support: icon image, bilingual
title, and bilingual description.
- The system shall allow draft, submit for review,
publish, and unpublish actions.
- The system shall display a Liferay generic success
toast message after each successful action.
Negative Scenarios:
- If mandatory fields are skipped: "{Field Name} is
required." {اسم الحقل} مطلوب.
- If the pillar icon is not uploaded: "Pillar Icon
is required." أيقونة الركيزة مطلوبة.
Post Condition:
- Strategic pillar cards are published and displayed in
the Strategic Direction section on the Home Page.
